description: Delete a CampaignMember record by its ID, or find and delete the first matching member for a campaign and lead or contact ID. When a CampaignMember ID is supplied, it is deleted directly without checking the campaign ID.

campaign_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to remove the member from.
campaign_id.human_parameter_description: The campaign you want to remove someone from. Paste the Salesforce Campaign ID (you can copy it from the campaign's URL).
campaign_id.title: Campaign Id

campaign_member_id.description: The specific CampaignMember record ID to delete. Either member_id or campaign_member_id must be provided.
campaign_member_id.human_parameter_description: The exact member-in-campaign record to delete. Use this if you have the specific Campaign Member ID to remove the link directly.
campaign_member_id.title: Campaign Member Id

member_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the lead or contact to remove from the campaign. Either member_id or campaign_member_id must be provided.
member_id.human_parameter_description: The lead or contact you want to remove. Enter their Salesforce ID if you don't have the specific Campaign Member ID.
member_id.title: Member Id

name: remove_from_campaign

RemoveFromCampaignResponse.description:
Response for successful campaign member removal.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful deletion.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().

message.description: Message when no campaign member was found or when validation fails.
message.title: Message

RemoveFromCampaignResponse.title: RemoveFromCampaignResponse
